suspension.reason: Owner directive after the OpenCode Go monthly quota was exhausted (HTTP 429 GoUsageLimitError, limitName=monthly).
suspension.authority: Direct Owner instruction 2026-10-10; confirmed by the Owner directive 2026-10-12 (Step 5 Preview only).
suspension.reactivation: Only a new direct Owner instruction sets runtime_status back to ACTIVE; quota recovery alone does not.

routing_policy.note: Owner directive 2026-10-12: Step 5 Preview (opencode/step-5-preview-free on OpenCode Zen) is the default and only active OpenCode executor for every lane (/oc, /assure, /ro-review, the launcher, the opencode-subagent MCP and every OpenCode subagent), at its highest native variant high (the Zen catalog lists low/medium/high only, no max). DeepSeek v4.1 Flash is SUSPENDED and never selected, not even as a fallback. Every earlier executor is retired and removed from this registry; its history stays in Git and in the dated records.
routing_policy.selection_authority: Every run resolves the step profile. Re-activating DeepSeek needs a new direct Owner instruction recorded in this registry.

resolution_policy.note: Exactly two logical executor profiles. All runtime model IDs below map to one of them; there is no third logical executor and no cross-family substitute. Step resolves only after live pinned-CLI catalog inspection of the Zen provider: its single admitted id must be listed, otherwise fail closed.

cross_executor_review_policy.note: MATERIAL implementation workstreams require a fresh-context READ-ONLY Step 5 Preview review of the exact validated implementation SHA and TREE before PR_READY or COMPLETE. Only the top-level read-only /ro-review lane (foundry-reviewer) can carry verifiable review evidence; a writable top-level run or a subagent it dispatches never satisfies the gate. While DeepSeek is SUSPENDED the implementation executor is also Step, so the review is same-model and its independence rests on the fresh context and read-only lane alone (review_independence). A later generated-state-only checkpoint may be NON_MATERIAL and preserves the reviewed validated implementation identity without claiming the later state commit was reviewed.
